reviewer: postal_model author; independent reviewer and root records are separate
scope: Eight previous-phase views for unchanged geometry plus three current-final directed views; image generation alone is not counted as viewing.

final_images.observation: Complete current building and flagstaff fit the frame; south/east colonnades, top gallery, single clock tower, copper crown and vaulted canopy visible. The repaired near shoulder dark panel is visible.

East curved shoulder shows the bounded narrow dark panel clearly outside the stone surface; adjacent clock edge, urn, entablature and three-figure silhouette visible. Target is the shoulder, not the full tower.

West curved shoulder shows the bounded narrow dark panel clearly with its shallow edge; adjacent single clock edge, urn, entablature and three-figure silhouette visible. Target is the shoulder, not the full tower.

earlier_images.observation: South/east giant-column layout, high gallery, complete single-clock tower and canopy visible. The missing shoulder panel in this version is superseded by final directed views.
East colonnade, curved single-clock shoulders, closed vaulted end glazing, bounded roof guards and two low roof objects visible.
North red-brick ordinary window rhythm and rear roof edge visible; no invented rear clock face.
Bounded U roof and estimated continuous barrel canopy relation visible; not a surveyed complete roof layout.
Arched entry, four entrance columns, raised museum wording, recessed glass and green spandrels visible.
Single front clock, real open paired-column pavilion, thick concave copper crown, flagstaff and simplified copper statuary visible; shoulder panels superseded.
Three distinct simplified heads/bodies in the near group, paired smooth column bases and actual raised postal wording visible; not exact historical bronze likenesses.
Red-brick face, regular recessed panes, roof canopy end and limited roof occupancy visible; detailed framing intentionally excludes complete tower top.

limitations: Small side dark marks are sealed shallow panels with estimated position and size, not interior windows.
Photographic exterior interpretation, not exact survey or a complete restoration; sculpture, roof details and courtyard plan are estimates.
Three final views do not replace the archived eight view hashes; neither set proves full current interior or courtyard state.
